canonical_adapters.Scene: base DTO unchanged; Scene.id=logical scene_id, Scene.revision=base version, editor algorithm|human, verified=meta.verified
canonical_adapters.FrameRef: ShotFrameRef same shape and valid instance of core FrameRef, stored in model_run_artifacts.frames_json and returned as canonical ModelRun.frames
canonical_adapters.Job: strict base Job unchanged; parent progress_done/total map to derived terminal_count/planned_count; extra parent metadata only via children response

scene_hash.algorithm: sha256 UTF8 canonical JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False
scene_hash.serialization_rule: Use the declared hash field names as JSON keys; column aliases are value sources only. All PTS/timebase/revision values are JSON integers (never bool/float/string); verified is JSON boolean; no extra keys.

config_hash: SHA256 canonical JSON of mode/config_profile/content_profile/custom_guidance/profile_id/template_sha256/think/num_ctx/num_predict/temperature/frame_selection_profile_id/scene_revision_hash. Same serialization as scene hash; never nonce/time. ModelRun.input_sha256 remains original media SHA; scene hash+actual FrameRefs distinguish shots.

canonical_domain_mapping.item_order: characters sorted by local_actor_id Unicode codepoint, then scene, then actions in original zero-based array order; route each item only to its declared observation or inference domain
canonical_domain_mapping.entry_serialization: Each nonempty language value produces one string: compact UTF-8 JSON object, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False. The JSON key set is {kind, lang, ref, text}; serialized key order MUST be kind, lang, ref, text (sort_keys=True), never insertion order. No translation, normalization, trim or deduplication; skip only exactly empty strings. Preserve raw model response byte-for-byte.

refs.action: decimal original zero-based action array index
refs.unknown: decimal original zero-based unknowns array index

canonical_domain_mapping.unknowns: Original unknowns array order, each zh then en; same JSON entry with kind=unknown into Domains.unknowns only.
canonical_domain_mapping.human_domains: Do not generate or overwrite user_evidence/creative_intent; merge only through explicit adoption with human locks taking precedence.
canonical_domain_mapping.prompt_text: summary.zh -> text_zh; summary.en -> text_en, exact copies. Missing language stays empty, no translation.
